quality.region_definition: replay frames strictly between the previous occurrence's protected core end and the next occurrence's protected core start
quality.finite_difference: np.gradient on the full 30 Hz chain replay, edge_order=2, then masked per region
quality.integral_attribution: trapezoid interval counted for a region only when both endpoints belong to that region
quality.analytic_connector_limits: each connector independently against the pair-policy peak and integral limits
quality.protected_source_defects: reported; acceleration and jerk inside protected cores are informational as in v5

validation.budget_note: Pair limits except wall time: a five-word chain is about 2.5x a pair replay; frozen before any sequence was verified.

case_note: The frozen hospital35 sequence cases that P1-3 left blocked only by TIMEOUT pairs of preflight-clear words, re-run on the retry-budget pair run. Directed engineering coverage only.
